sentences.text: For the reasons assigned, I.A.No.20230 of 2023 an application for amendment is allowed.
The learned counsel for appellant to make necessary amendment in the appeal memo and to file an amended memo of appeal within a week.

Heard on I.A. No.9705 of 2023.
2.

This is the first application seeking for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of accused/appellant - Harwinda who has been convicted under Sections 363, 366 and 376 (2) (N) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 5 years, R.I. for 7 years and R.I. for 20 years and to pay a fine of Rs.2,000/-, Rs.3,000/- and Rs.10,000/- respectively with default stipulations, (all sentences to run concurrently) vide impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 19.04.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, District Tikamgarh in Special Case No.19 of 2019.

sentences.text: 3. The case of the prosecution is that on 05.10.2018 at about 12.00 p.m, the applicant abducted the victim who is a minor girl and thereafter he forcibly committed sexual intercourse with the victim.
On the basis of the complaint, the police lodged the report and the aforesaid offences came to be registered against the present appellant.
After investigation charge sheet was filed against the appellant.
After trial, he was convicted and sentenced as mentioned hereinabove.
4. It is argued that the victim and the appellant were known to each other.
The appellant and the victim have solemnized marriage as is reflected from the statement of victim (PW-3).

He has drawn the attention of this Court to para 4 of the statement of PW-3 wherein she has categorically stated that while they were going, on the way, the appellant has solemnized marriage with the victim in a Shiv Mandir.
The appellant is in jail since 23.04.2019.
He was on bail during trial and has not misused the liberty granted to him.

He is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the conditions which may be imposed by this Court while considering his application for suspension of Harwinda vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55595205/
1 sentence.

sentences.text: On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail.
5. State counsel has vehemently opposed the contentions stating therein that the victim was minor at the time of commission of offence.

She was aged about 17 years, therefore, there is no value of consent of a minor but he could not dispute the factum of the statement of victim, wherein she has stated that the victim as well as the appellant have solemnized marriage and they were known to each other.
However, he has prayed for dismissal of the application.
6. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and without commenting upon the merits, we deem it just and necessary to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Consequently, I.A. No.9705 of 2023 is allowed.

7. Subject to deposit of the fine amounts, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant/accused - Harwinda shall remain suspended and he is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court/concerned Court on 08.01.2024 and thereafter on such other subsequent dates as may be fixed in that behalf.

(RAVI MALIMATH) (VISHAL MISHRA)
 CHIEF JUSTICE JUDGE  AM Harwinda vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55595205/
